name: Station battery low-voltage alarm block
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Applies the documented battery-bus low-voltage supervision to its assigned alarm output.
description: Applies the documented battery-bus low-voltage supervision to its assigned alarm output. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Battery-bus voltage” at the input and “Low-voltage alarm state” at the output. Voltage is not a direct measure of usable capacity.

Identify every source, protective device, isolation boundary and return. Battery capacity, DC fault duty, charging settings and ventilation require the selected battery-system design; illustrative circuits do not establish autonomy. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
